name: 伊柏文
objective:
1. 機器學習簡介及基本概念
2. 用於分類、迴歸和分群的機器學習演算法
3. 機器學習模型訓練、評估與最佳化技術
4. 機器學習在光電系統的應用
1.	Introduction and basic concepts of machine learning
2.	Machine learning algorithms for classification, regression and clustering
3.	Machine learning model training, evaluation, and optimization technology
4.	Application of machine learning in optoelectronic systems
schedule:
Week 1:        Course overview 
Week 2.        Introduction and basic concepts of machine learning
Week 3.        Types of Machine learning 
Week 4-9.     Machine learning algorithms for classification, regression and   clustering 
Week  10-13.   Machine learning model training, evaluation, and optimization     technology 
Wek 14-17. Application of machine learning in optoelectronic systems
Week 18. Final Project presentation
scorePolicy:
HomeWorks: 40%
Lab Quiz's : 20%
Class Participation and Attendance: 10%
Final project and report: 30%
materials:
References:

1.  Ethem Alpaydin, Introduction to Machine Learning, PHI 3rd edition, 2014

2. Peter Flach, Machine Learning: the art and science of algorithms that make sense of data, Cambridge university press, edition 2012.
